title: Setup takes time too
hook: Ten minutes of work plus five minutes of setup is a fifteen-minute booking.

knows: reading short labels and comparing simple counts
doesNotKnow: Include setup duration rather than just execution time.

objective: Include setup duration rather than just execution time.

claims.text: Scenario, hook and prediction: Ten minutes of work plus five minutes of setup is a fifteen-minute booking. How long is this combined setup-and-work block? Correct option: 15 minutes. All fixture labels, example words, dates, task durations and file fields are stipulated exercise data.

claims.text: The first block includes the visible five-minute setup and ten-minute execution. The calendar cannot fit fifteen minutes inside a ten-minute allowance.
